description: Aura Phase-K = masterplan Phase 7A (Compact Archive Hygiene) — the immediate trigger from the 2026-05-15 live debug: compact_memory_documents was returning raw tool errors / schema dumps / AGENT.md dumps / stdout snippets / assistant loop scaffolding (docs/aura-interactive-debug-report-2026-05-15.md). Three parallel audits converged on a single-line fix: internal/storage/memoryindex/rebuild.go:308-324 `IndexingTurnAppender.Append` writes every conversations row to compact_memory_documents without role/content filtering. Scope: ONLY role=tool exclusion (Phase07A plan §Stop Signals — schema-dependent distinctions defer to Phase07B/C). NO data deletion, NO migration, NO retrieval-surface rewrite. Each story = ONE atomic commit on master. userStories.title: Wire ArchiveEligibility into IndexingTurnAppender.Append + Rebuild
userStories.description: Apply US-K01 policy at BOTH ingress points of compact_memory_documents so live-append and full-rebuild produce the same compact-archive set. (a) IndexingTurnAppender.Append (internal/storage/memoryindex/rebuild.go:308-324 per audit docs/phase07-current-rag-audit-2026-05-16.md section B): consult ArchiveEligibility(role, content); if !eligible, return nil (do NOT write to compact_memory_documents but DO NOT block the caller — the conversations row is independent and already persisted upstream). (b) Rebuild function (find via grep `func.*Rebuild` in rebuild.go): same gate applied during full rebuild — iterate conversations, skip ineligible. (c) Parity test in rebuild_test.go: a fixture of 10 conversations rows (mix of user/assistant/tool/system); both Append and Rebuild produce the SAME compact_memory_documents set (assert via row count + ordered id list). (d) Logging: when an Append call is skipped, emit slog.Debug('compact_archive_skipped', 'role', role, 'reason', reason) — Debug not Info, this is a hot path. (e) conversations table writes are UNCHANGED — verify via archive_turns_test.go regression that role='tool' rows still appear in conversations after this commit.
